verdict.rationale: SerpApi offers a markdown output format 'optimized for LLMs and AI agents' and a 'fields' parameter to reduce payload size, plus an llms.txt and .md doc endpoints and an official MCP server, all supporting LLM/RAG-context consumption. However there's no evidence of ranking/relevance scoring, chunking, token-size targeting, or embedding-ready formatting tailored specifically for RAG retrieval quality. missing for 10: explicit ranking/relevance signals for RAG, token/size-aware truncation controls, embedding or chunking support, independent benchmarks of markdown output quality for LLM context.
